name: DexHand021 Concept
summary: DexHand021 Concept is DexRobot's original five-finger dexterous-hand concept and an open platform for robotic manipulation development. The official presentation describes 18 degrees of freedom, five kinds of perception and a highly integrated hand assembly. Each of the five fingers can be replaced independently, and the platform is intended to support common robotic end-effector interfaces and data formats. The manufacturer also describes posture holding without power consumption. This record refers specifically to the concept version; specifications for the later mass-production model do not
